annotation.title_en: ISO/WD 26058-1 - Safety requirements for industrial mobile robots — Part 1: Industrial mobile robots
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for working draft ISO/WD 26058-1, a Type C safety standard for ground-travelling industrial mobile robots in industrial environments. It is the first part of a series; Part 2 will cover application integration. It lists scope exclusions, such as industrial trucks, exoskeletons, road vehicles and floor-cleaning robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Type C safety standard for ground-based industrial mobile robots in workplaces with restricted public access
Part 1 of a series; Part 2 will address safety of application integration
Excludes industrial trucks (ISO 3691-4), actively stability-controlled robots (ISO/NP 25785-1), road vehicles and exoskeletons
Excludes non-industrial, agricultural, mining, floor-cleaning, airborne and underwater machines
Hazards not covered include explosive or nuclear environments, ionizing radiation and person transport
